HOW IT WORKS

Three simple steps to your next getaway

No stress, no endless searching — just share your vision and we handle the rest.

1️⃣

Share your trip details — destination, dates, travelers, and budget.

2️⃣

Receive curated options with resort, cruise, and destination comparisons.

3️⃣

Approve your favorite, book with a low deposit, and travel with confidence.

MEET YOUR TRAVEL AGENT

About Pharin Walker

Owner & Travel Agent · Destined 4 Destinations LLC

Hi, I'm Pharin Walker

Owner & Travel Agent · Destined 4 Destinations

Travel isn't just about visiting new places — it's about creating unforgettable memories that last a lifetime. That's why I founded Destined 4 Destinations: to help individuals, couples, families, and groups experience the world with confidence, ease, and excitement.

Since launching my agency in 2018, I've had the privilege of helping travelers plan everything from dream honeymoons and destination weddings to Disney vacations, luxury all-inclusive resorts, cruises, family reunions, birthday celebrations, and bucket-list adventures around the world.

I believe every vacation should be as unique as the traveler taking it. Whether you're looking for a relaxing Caribbean escape, an unforgettable European journey, or a magical family vacation, I take the time to understand your vision and create an experience designed specifically for you.

Why Book With Me?

  • ✔ Personalized vacation planning
  • ✔ Expert destination knowledge
  • ✔ Stress-free booking experience
  • ✔ Group travel coordination
  • ✔ Disney & Universal vacation planning
  • ✔ Cruises & luxury all-inclusive resorts
  • ✔ Destination weddings & honeymoons
  • ✔ Ongoing support before, during, and after your trip

Setup Instructions

              
    
                
  1. Go to script.google.com → New Project
    2. 
                
  2. Delete the existing code and paste the Apps Script code (click button below)
    3. 
                
  3. Click Deploy → New deployment
    4. 
                
  4. Type: Web app · Execute as: Me · Who has access: Anyone
    5. 
                
  5. Click Deploy → copy the Web App URL
    6. 
                
  6. Paste that URL in the field above and click Save
    7.
